note: P4071 (Pro 17:17) — a friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

dims.v: faithful love — a friend loves at all times
the constant, faithful love of a friend, which does not fail in any season, and the brotherly love born for adversity
the steadfast love that holds through every time and trouble

aheb (love) — 'a friend LOVES at all times, and a brother is born for adversity'; the great word on faithful friendship — true love is constant, not fair-weather, and kinship-love is proven in trouble. Love that endures every season and rises in hardship.
